subject.title: fix: show billing error for exhausted OpenAI quota

question: Should the repository accept structured `billing` as more specific than an ambiguous message-level `rate_limit` across providers, rather than limit this exception to OpenAI?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes the shared classifier rather than an OpenAI-owned mapping, while the PR description frames the user case as OpenAI-specific; a human should confirm that shared contract.

options.title: Accept shared precedence
options.body: Merge the focused generic rule because structured billing details are the more actionable classification when they conflict with an ambiguous quota message.

options.title: Scope to OpenAI
options.body: Require an OpenAI-specific classification path if maintainers want other providers to retain message-level rate-limit precedence.

recommendation.title: Accept shared precedence
recommendation.body: Merge the focused generic rule because structured billing details are the more actionable classification when they conflict with an ambiguous quota message.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence ties this contributor directly to the proposed shared-classifier change; broader feature-history ownership could not be established from the read-only inspection path.
